overview.text: The tender is for empanelment and rate contract for supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and maintenance (comprehensive SLA) of Biometric Access Control System (BACS), as well as comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (CAMC) of existing BACS.
The issuing organization is the State Bank of India (SBI), Administrative Office, Bhubaneswar.
The tender is issued through the Government E-Marketplace (GeM) Portal.
The tender duration is for a period of 2 + 1 years.
The Biding document includes an overview of requirements, bidding procedures, and contact terms.
The Bank has made considerable effort to ensure accurate information is contained in this Tender but supplies it solely as guidelines for Bidders.
If the Bidder fails to furnish all required information or submits a bid not responsive to the bidding documents, it will be at the Bidder's risk and may result in rejection.
The RFP is for the supply, installation, and maintenance of a Biometric Access Control System (BACS) for SBI Administrative Office branches.
Currently, there are 5 Currency Chest Branches out of a total of 235 branches/complexes where the system is installed.
The contract period shall be valid for 2 years, reviewable yearly based on performance, and potentially extendable by an additional year at Bank's discretion.
The work involves furnishing labor, material, equipment, and appliances to install, maintain, and service the Biometric Access Control System (BACS).
The RFP is for a Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract involving Biometric Access Control Systems (BACS) at Currency Chest Branches.

The work is to be carried out across approximately 235 branches/offices/complexes/establishments of State Bank of India (SBI), specifically focused on Currency Chest Branches in the Bhubaneswar region.
The tender process includes a Pre-Bid meeting held via GeM Portal where bidders can submit queries, and clarifications/amendments are communicated as corrigendum/addenda.
The issuing organization is the Assistant General Manager (Operations), AO, Bhubaneswar, representing State Bank of India (SBI).
SBI (Assistant General Manager Operations) reserves the right to amend, rescind, or reissue the tender at any time prior to the deadline.
No requests for changes in commercial or legal terms and conditions will be entertained other than what is mentioned in the tender or addenda/corrigenda.
Queries received after the scheduled date and time will not be responded to or acted upon.
The vendor must commence new installation work within two weeks of receiving the supply order or letter of award.
The rate contract is valid for 02 plus 01 years from the issue of the letter of award, subject to annual performance review.
The vendor is responsible for application/implementation of labour laws and compensation for injury or accident to persons employed by it.
The cost of testing items supplied or materials used must be borne by the vendor, including revised/updated certifications.
The vendor must have a technical support SLA with the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) for 05 years applicable to the entire contract period.
The Bank reserves the right to cancel the contract if the bidder fails to agree on terms within 07 days of receiving the award communication.
The contract authority to penalize the vendor is vested with the Assistant General Manager (Operations), State Bank of India, Administrative Office, Bhubaneswar.
The courts at Bhubaneswar shall alone have jurisdiction in this regard for this Tender.
The warranty period for the new supply of the Biometric Access Control System is two years from the date of installation against manufacturing and functional defects.
Disputes shall first be resolved through joint discussions of Authorized Representatives before being referred to an Arbitrator.
The Bank reserves the right to instantly revoke or cancel the contract on grounds of proven deficiencies, inability, or failure in fulfilling contractual obligations.
The Bank reserves the right to terminate the entire contract without assigning reasons for delays beyond specified periods, serious discrepancies in work conduct, or breaches of terms and conditions.
If a bidder uses fraudulent methods or falsifies documents, the Bank may terminate the contract without notice and impose penalties.
The tender is for the supply, installation, commissioning, and comprehensive annual maintenance contract (AMC) of Biometric Access Control Systems (BACS) and existing BACS (as-is basis).
The tender applies to branches/offices/complexes of the State Bank of India Administrative Office in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
Bids must be submitted online via the Bank's e-tender portal.

The RFP is for the Supply, Installation, Commissioning and Maintenance (Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract) of Biometric Access Control Systems (BACS) for branches/offices/complexes of SBI Administrative Office Bhubaneswar.
The tender process involves submitting online bids via the Bank's e-tender portal, subject to pre-bid clarifications and site inspections.
The issuing organization is Assistant General Manager (Operations), State Bank of India, located at Administrative Office Bhubaneswar.
The RFP invites applications for a Contract for Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning (SITC) and Maintenance of Biometric Access Control System (BACS).
Invitation of application does not guarantee the issue of Work Order.
The contract tenure is for one year, extendable to a maximum total of three years subject to satisfactory performance and annual review.
Successful bidder(s) are not permitted to subcontract or outsource manpower for the awarded job.
The work contract is nontransferable.
The document is a Standard Service Level Agreement (Annexure 'H') for the Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) of the Biometric Access Control System (BACS).
The agreement is between State Bank of India ('The Bank') and an AMC Vendor Firm referred to as 'M/s. ABC'.
The vendor was selected by the Bank based on participation in a Request for Proposal (RFP) dated in blank.
The RFP is for an Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) covering the Biometric Access Control System (BACS) at bank branches.
There are currently 5 currency chest branches requiring service.
This document contains terms of agreement, annexures for certificates (Installation and Maintenance), and contact signatures related to Biometric Access Control System (BACS) service.
The contract execution location is determined by the location of the respective LHO (Local Head Office).
The tender ID is AO BBSR: AO/BHU/SEC/2025 -26/04.
The tender document is dated 13.01.2026.

The work involves the supply, installation, testing & commissioning of new Biometric Access Control Systems (BACS) and comprehensive annual maintenance (AMC) at Currency Chest Branches/Offices/Complexes of Administrative Office, Bhubaneswar.
The RFP period is one year for the estimate but requires bidding for a duration of three years.

scope.text: Comprehensive AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) including ancillary work of existing Biometric Access Control System (BACS).
Supply, Installation, commissioning (including ancillary work) of New Biometric Access Control System (BACS) and their maintenance.
Services are required for branches/offices/complexes of SBI Administrative Office Bhubaneswar, Bhubaneswar Circle, located in the State of Odisha.
The Bank requires SUPPLY, INSTALLATION, COMMISSIONING AND MAINTENANCE (COMPREHENSIVE ANNUAL MAINTENANCE CONTRACT) OF BIOMETRIC ACCESS CONTROL SYSTEM (BACS).
The work includes COMPREHENSIVE ANNUAL MAINTENANCE CONTRACT OF EXISTING BIOMETRIC ACCESS CONTROL SYSTEM (BACS) (AS IS WHERE IS BASIS).
The project is for BRANCHES/OFFICES/ESTABLISHMENT OF SBI ADMISNISTRATIVE OFFICE, BHUBANESWAR, ODISHA.
Currently installed at 05 (FIVE) CURRENCY CHEST BRANCHES OUT OF TOTAL OF 235 BRANCHES / OFFICES / COMPLEXES / ESTABLISHMENTS.
The work consists of furnishing all labor, material, equipment, and appliances necessary to install and maintain the BACS and AMC of existing systems.
The scope includes supply, installation, commissioning, testing, and comprehensive annual maintenance of BACS at branches.
Installation work must be executed as per the Bank's technical specifications mentioned in the NIT.
The vendor must provide replacement for faulty equipment including switches, sensors, testing push buttons, indicators, and power supply modules.
The AMC scope explicitly excludes replacement of the entire BACS panel, changes in wiring, and damage caused by lightning, fire, arson, or flooding.
The vendor must ensure mandatory visits once a month for Currency Chest Branches with no gaps less than 20 days between visits.
Services include checking the BACS control panel location, testing system functions and power supply, mapping and updating custodian fingerprints, and training bank staff.
The vendor must provide an AMC report quarterly with a time-wise breakdown via email in Excel format to the AGM (Ops) of Bhubaneswar.
The vendor must set up compatibility and integration of the Biometric Access Control System with the Central Monitoring Station (CMS).
Supply and installation of Biometric Access Control Systems (BACS) at identified locations, sites, branches, offices, or establishments.
Contract term validity of 02 years plus an additional 1 year, subject to annual review of vendor performance.
The vendor must complete Supply and Installation work and obtain an Installation Certificate signed by the Bank's authorized officer as per Annexure-'B'.
Maintenance certificates must be signed by the Branch Manager or Bank's authorized officer, and a sample copy is provided in Annexure-'C'.

The vendor assumes full responsibility for indemnifying the Bank against damages to building/equipment, injuries, or accidents during work execution.

The vendor is liable for all injuries, loss of life, property damage, or customer claims caused by negligence during work execution.

The vendor is responsible for applying labor laws, social security enactments, and compensating for injuries to employees.
The Bank reserves the right to arrange testing of supplied items by competent agencies; all testing costs are borne by the vendor.

The vendor must have a technical support SLA with the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) for 05 years covering supply, installation, testing, commissioning, maintenance, software, spares, repair, upgrades, and compatibility without extra cost to the Bank.

Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) charges include all type of repairs and replacements except UPS battery and items damaged by proven electrical fault, fire, flood, or willful damage.
The AMC includes cleaning, servicing, maintenance, and demonstration of the complete Biometric Access Control System (BACS).
The vendor must carry out maintenance visits on a monthly basis for currency chest branches compulsorily even if no complaint is lodged.

The AMC covers supply, installation, testing, commissioning, maintenance, repairing, arranging compatibility with the Central Monitoring System, and upgrades without incurring extra cost to the Bank for a period of 05 years.
The vendor must attend to unforeseen, reasonable requirements of the Bank during operations/currency of the contract.

Insurance shall be equal to 110 percent of the contract value on an All Risks basis, valid until project completion or handing over.
The contractor is responsible for reinstating all damages and satisfying claims for damages to third-party property.

The scope includes Supply, Installation, and Commissioning of Biometric Access Control Systems (BACS).
The scope includes a Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for new BACS.
The scope includes a Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for existing BACS on an 'as-is where is' basis.
Work covers approximately 235 Branches/Offices/Complexes/Establishments under SBI AO Bhubaneswar across five Regional Business Offices (RBOs).
Scope includes supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and maintenance of Biometric Access Control Systems.
Specific services include replacement of defective parts/equipment/fixtures with same or better equipment under the AMC.

Services include Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning (SITC) and maintenance of Biometric Access Control System (BACS).

Contract includes product, software, spares, repair, and upgrading services with OEM technical support.
The scope includes maintenance services for Biometric Access Control System (BACS) installed at different Currency Chest Branches of the Bank.

Services cover thorough check-ups, testing, servicing, cleaning, inspection, and maintenance of complete BACS and its accessories like control panels, scanners, wires, hooks/mounts, switches, keypads, displays, and batteries.
Vendor must check BACS serviceability and ensure the system is switched on 24x7, apprising the Branch Manager and Security Officer if otherwise found.
Maintenance includes checking BACS working on UPS/Battery back-up when regular power supply is switched off.
Vendor must train bank staff on operations, special features, data/log retrieval, and troubleshooting of the BACS.
Services include rectification of equipment and replacement of worn out or defective parts.
Maintenance involves retrieval of BACS data/logs as required by the Bank.
Installation and maintenance of Biometric Access Control System (BACS) at bank branches/office.
Reporting requirements for service visits including completion of SGMS (Security Gadget Monitoring System) updates.
Exclusion of GST from charges borne by the Vendor, to be reimbursed by the Bank upon proof submission.
Installation and maintenance of Biometric Access Control Systems (BACS) at branch locations.
Components include Biometric readers, Electromagnetic Locks, Exit Switch Metals, Batteries, L/U/ZL Brackets, Adapters, MCBs, Power Supplies, and PVC conduits/casing.
Installation charges (including data/log retrieval) are listed at Rs. 1,620 per visit.
Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) charges are quoted as Rs. 540 per branch/system/visit.
The estimated total AMC for one year is Rs. 32,400 per branch/system.
The estimated total AMC for three years is Rs. 97,200 per branch/system.
Five-year warranty against any manufactured defect applies to quoted prices.
